title: Civil Rights Act of 1964 — Statute profile
subject: Civil Rights Act of 1964
summary: Civil Rights Act of 1964 is a statute of United States enacted in 1964, in the area of civil rights. Landmark law banning discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 88-352.
key_points: Core effect: Landmark law banning discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, or national origin.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
